run_Model_training: run the Model training loop with a Generator to train a self-supervised contrastive neural network
create_Generator_data: create a Generator instance to produce synthetic signal and noise data pairs for training
build_Model_architecture: build a Model with an extractor, ReLU activation, and predictor for contrastive learning
review_Model_forward: review the Model forward pass that normalizes branch outputs and returns contrastive pairs
test_Generator_generate: test the Generator generate method to produce batched x1 and x2 data pairs
